# law_multicultural
REPLACE:law_multicultural = {
	is_visible = {
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_multicultural_upgraded }
	}
	on_activate = {
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_bpm_multicultural_upgrade }
	}
	modifier = {
		bpm_decorative_upgradable_law = yes
		country_support_separatism_resistance_mult = -0.25
		country_support_separatism_strength_mult = 0.25
		state_pop_support_movement_cultural_minority_mult = 0.5
		country_acceptance_no_shared_heritage_trait_add = -10
		country_acceptance_shared_language_trait_group_add = -5
		country_acceptance_no_shared_language_trait_add = -10
		country_acceptance_shared_tradition_trait_add = 10
		country_acceptance_no_shared_tradition_trait_add = 0
	}
	acceptance_modifier = {
		country_political_strength_violent_hostility_mult = -0.3
		country_political_strength_cultural_erasure_mult = -0.2
		country_political_strength_open_prejudice_mult = -0.1
		country_political_strength_second_rate_citizen_mult = 0.1
		country_political_strength_full_acceptance_mult = 0.1
	}
	is_visible = {
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_cosmopolitanism }
	}
}

# law_sakoku
REPLACE:law_sakoku = {
	group = lawgroup_trade_policy
	parent = law_isolationism
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/law_icons/sakoku.dds"
	progressiveness = -50
	requires_law_or = {
		law_traditionalism
	}
	is_visible = {
		country_has_primary_culture = cu:japanese
		any_scope_state = {
			state_region = s:STATE_KYUSHU
			is_largest_state_in_region = yes
		}
		has_law = law_type:law_sakoku
	}
	modifier = {
		country_authority_mult = 0.25
		country_influence_mult = -0.50
		country_tech_spread_mult = -0.20
		state_trade_capacity_mult = -0.75
		state_tariff_import_add = 0.50
		state_tariff_export_add = 0.50
		state_subvention_export_add = 0.20
		state_subvention_import_add = 0.20
		country_leverage_resistance_mult = 0.75
		country_disallow_trade_outside_kyushu_bool = yes
		state_trade_center_max_limit_add = 5
		country_disallow_aggressive_plays_bool = yes
		country_rigidity_baseline_add = 10
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		OR = {
			has_journal_entry = je_sakoku
			ruler = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_activate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_game_started = yes
				NOT = {
					has_law = law_type:law_closed_borders
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = internal_controls_strengthened_tt
			activate_law = law_type:law_closed_borders
		}
	}
	on_deactivate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_closed_borders
			}
			custom_tooltip = internal_controls_relaxed_tt
			activate_law = law_type:law_migration_controls
		}
	}
	ai_enact_weight_modifier = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { ai_has_enact_weight_modifier_journal_entries = yes }
			add = 750
		}
	}
}
